UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331
V.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED
CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE NOTICE OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD
DEVELOPMENT RELEVANT TO ECF NOS. 93 AND 97-99
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves under Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) for leave to file the
Notice of Subsequent Record Development attached as Exhibit A. A Memorandum in Support
accompanies this Motion.
I.
GROUNDS
Local
Civil Rule 7(F)(1) provides that "[n]o further briefs or written
communications may be filed without first obtaining leave of Court."
ECF No. 93 (Motion for Targeted Vacatur of ECF Nos. 64 and 84, Withdrawal or
Modification of the Magistrate-Judge Referral, and Related Interim Relief) and ECF Nos. 97-99
(Rule 72(a) Objections to ECF No. 96 and related requests) are pending before the District Judge.
1

Plaintiff's consolidated reply in support of ECF Nos. 90 and 93 was filed October 28, 2026. ECF
No. 102.
On October 29, 2026, Magistrate Judge Fitzpatrick signed ECF No. 108. It was
filed October 29, 2026 and entered on the docket October 30, 2026. ECF No. 108 is a subsequent
exercise of the designation. The authority and procedure that produced that designation are the
subject of ECF No. 97 9 15 and ECF No. 99, Part V. ECF No. 108 attributes to the District Judge
a decision to refrain from beginning discovery until resolution of the pending motions to dismiss.
ECF No. 108 at 2. It postdates ECF No. 102 and ECF Nos. 97-99.
Il.
SCOPE
4.
The proposed Notice is confined to ECF No. 108. It addresses its date, its stated
premise, and its relationship to the relief already requested in ECF No. 93 9 10(R1), (R5), and (R6)
and ECF No. 97 19 15 and 20(6)-(7). It repeats no argument from ECF Nos. 94, 99, or 102 and
adds no ground. Plaintiff's motions under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 54(b), filed separately,
request reconsideration of ECF No. 108 insofar as it denied ECF Nos. 103 and 105. This Motion
does not request that reconsideration.
2

ILI.
RELIEF
Plaintiff requests leave to file Exhibit A. Plaintiff requests that it be deemed filed
as of the date of the Court's order. Plaintiff requests that the Court consider it in resolving ECF
Nos. 93 and 97-99, with such opportunity for Defendants to respond as the Court directs. A
proposed order accompanies this Motion.
Date: November 1, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com

Relevant to ECF Nos. 93 and 97-99, with its Certificate of Service, Local Civil Rule 83.1(N)
Certification, and Generative Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification;
Memorandum in Support;
Exhibit A (Proposed Notice of Subsequent Record Development); and
4.
Proposed Order.
Counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie
Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc. are registered users of the Court's Case Management/Electronic
Case Filing (CM/ECF) system. Upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission, the CM/ECF system

Date: November 1, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
